info.title: S04 synthetic account-information bank contract
info.description: New synthetic development contract for account-information calls. This reserved server is for offline contract and mock checks only. It does not authorize deployment or a live bank call. Opaque wire values have the meanings supplied by this run's approved source material.

servers.description: Reserved synthetic offline-only target; never deploy this contract.

post.description: CALL for each permitted factor answer in the source-defined factor order. A successful request is accepted=true; only matched=true verifies the submitted factor. Send the exact subject_ref from the read-only call context. The returned remaining counter is cumulative across factors. Advice does not establish a successful match or consume an attempt by itself.

200.description: Identity answer checked; matched states whether this factor passed.

post.summary: Read the verified customer's account information
post.description: CALL exactly once after all permitted identity factors have passed. A successful response has accepted=true and one or two holdings in bank-returned order. Copy identifiers and scalar facts unchanged. Disclosure is limited to the fields explicitly permitted by the effective source policy; internal age_days and arrears_amount do not authorize collection activity.

CALL once as the last bank tool action after the source-required goodbye. Use the exact completion_tag and, when required, detail_tag from the effective source outcome table. Omit detail_tag for C81; supply the source-required reason for every other outcome. accepted=true establishes recorded closure; sending the request does not. No retry or further bank action is authorized after any close result.

200.description: The exact submitted subject and disposition were recorded.

SubjectRef.description: Exact bank customer identifier supplied in the read-only call context; never infer or invent an identifier.

FactorTag.description: Source-defined identity factor codes: F21 means birth_year; F22 means postal_suffix.

CompletionTag.description: Source-defined outcomes: C81 informed, C82 not_verified, C83 not_reached, C84 information_incomplete, C85 service_failure. Information outcomes are not payment or collection outcomes.

DetailTag.description: Source-defined reasons: R14 failed, R15 declined, R16 wrong_number, R17 unclear, R18 refused, R19 service_error. Absent only for informed C81; present with the supplied reason for every other source outcome.

factor_reply.description: The caller's answer to the selected source-defined identity question, normalized only as the effective source permits.

accepted.description: Positive service success flag; not by itself evidence that identity matched.

matched.description: True only when the exact submitted factor was verified.

remaining.description: Authoritative number of wrong answers remaining across all identity factors.

advice.description: Optional bank advice; no value implies no hint. Never treat advice as a matched factor.

fault.description: Optional bank error text; never a substitute for accepted and matched flags.

Holding.description: One bank-returned product. Common fields are required on every product. tail_digits is required by the service for K11 only, installment_minor for K12 only, and yield_bps for K13 only; these conditional fields remain optional in the shared flat schema and have no inferred or default values. The disclosure controller validates only source-permitted fields for the actual kind_tag.

holding_ref.description: Exact opaque product identifier, unique within this account result; never disclose or invent it.

kind_tag.description: K11 card, K12 loan, K13 deposit, as mapped by the supplied source.

age_days.description: Internal days_late scalar retained for controller compatibility; not a disclosure permission or a collection goal.

arrears_amount.description: Internal past_due scalar retained for controller compatibility; not a disclosure permission or a collection goal.

label_text.description: Bank product display name; disclose only when the effective source permits.

balance_minor.description: Bank balance in currency minor units; disclose only for source-permitted product kinds.

currency_tag.description: Source-defined currency codes: X91 GBP; X92 EUR.

tail_digits.description: Bank card's final four digits. Required for K11; disclose only for a card when the effective source permits.

installment_minor.description: Loan installment in currency minor units. Required for K12; disclose only for a loan when the effective source permits.

yield_bps.description: Deposit interest in basis points. Required for K13; disclose only for a deposit when the effective source permits.

accepted.description: Positive evidence that the exact customer's account information was loaded.

holdings.description: One or two products in the exact returned bank order. holding_ref values are unique.

fault.description: Optional bank error text; never establishes loaded account facts.

accepted.description: Positive evidence that closure was recorded for the exact returned identifier and disposition.

fault.description: Optional bank error text; not evidence of recorded closure.

accepted.description: Explicit service failure; no successful identity, account-load, or closure fact is established.

fault.description: Bank error text. Failure does not authorize guessing account facts or retrying closure.

RejectedRequest.description: Request rejected without establishing a successful action fact.

UnverifiedRequest.description: Account access rejected because the customer's required identity factors are not verified.

UnavailableService.description: Service could not provide positive action evidence. This response grants no retry permission.
